title: A chat weight given while a typed weight is still saving reads the weight step as open (US-62 AC31a residual)
evidence: Partial 2026-11-14 (PR 1707): the box route is fixed (the chat-weight gate also asks that the box holds no plausible typed weight; useOnboarding waitsOn). Still open: a grid weight committed on leaving the matrix (StartingInfoVitals useSaveOnLeave), its save in flight, still reads the weight step as open, so a chat weight can spend a typed birth year's pending landing. Focus and landing only. Also no pin yet for the inputRangeFault half of the gate. The inputRangeFault pin needs the hook level (useOnboarding chatWeight(open)): a page-level pin built on PR 1713 still passed with that half of the gate removed, so it was not committed. Was: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:533 chatWeight gate reads weightStepOpen(previousMeasurements), saved rows only. A weight typed and left in the box whose 500 ms save, or a grid commit on leaving the matrix (StartingInfoVitals useSaveOnLeave), has not landed still reads as open, so a chat weight in that window calls answered(false) and can spend a typed birth year's pending landing.
